The physics (wave-vector mismatch, acceptance widths) is already encoded in the model; the solver only needs to apply existing tools correctly. No novel derivation or deep domain expertise is required beyond understanding the fitting model.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of about six sequential steps (multiple curve fits, one regression, arithmetic), each straightforward with scipy/numpy. The main engineering challenge is handling the sinc² fitting (initial guesses, potential local minima), but the data is clean and the model is simple. No multi-tool orchestration, heavy environment setup, or data acquisition is needed.
